    # Calculate the minimum energy loss for each step
    energy_loss = 0
    
    # Move along the x-axis
    energy_loss += (X - 0) * B  # Move along x-axis
    energy_loss += (Y - 0) * B  # Move along y-axis
    energy_loss += (Z - 0) * B  # Move along z-axis
    
    # Adjust for overlapping moves
    energy_loss -= (min(X, Y) * B)  # Subtract the overlap of x and y moves
    energy_loss -= (min(Y, Z) * B)  # Subtract the overlap of y and z moves
    energy_loss -= (min(X, Z) * B)  # Subtract the overlap of x and z moves
    
    # Add the direct moves
    energy_loss += (abs(X - Y) * B)  # Move from x to y
    energy_loss += (abs(Y - Z) * B)  # Move from y to z
    energy_loss += (abs(X - Z) * B)  # Move from x to z
    
    # Add the corner moves
